description: This file is a proxy script generated by Composer for executing the 'jp.php' binary from the 'mtdowling/jmespath.php' package. It handles stream wrapping and version compatibility for PHP versions below 8.0, providing an environment to run the binary script within PHP scripts.

classes.name: Composer inProxyWrapper
classes.description: A stream wrapper class that proxies file stream operations to handle conditional shebang removal and stream behaviors.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Initialize stream, open referenced file, and handle shebang removal on first read.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Read data from the stream, stripping shebang line on initial read.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Apply or release a lock on the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seek within the stream and update position.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Check if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Return stream statistics (placeholder in this implementation).

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Retrieve statistics for the URL, supporting its custom stream wrapper.
